title: Law to require bilingual Chinese street signs in Chinatown
summary: This bill would require the Department of Transportation to study Chinatown's borders and install Chinese-English street signs throughout the area at a rate of at least 50 signs per year, reassessing the borders every 50 years. It would also require DOT to replace damaged bilingual signs citywide and let Council members or the Public Advocate request bilingual signs elsewhere, subject to limits and community board approval. DOT would also have to publish an online portal, searchable map and database tracking all bilingual street signs.
